newsitem.title: GREECE: BANK/CYPRUS LAUNCHES PERSONAL LOAN IN FOREX.
newsitem.headline: BANK/CYPRUS LAUNCHES PERSONAL LOAN IN FOREX.

text.p: Bank of Cyprus, Athens, has introduced a new personal loan for the equivalent of one million drachmas in dollars, marks, pounds, yens and ecus, it said in a statement.
The new personal forex loan called CY-ONE will be paid off in 12 monthly installments at interest rates ranging from 6.25 percent to 12 percent depending on the foreign currency, it said.
The bank has been offering the new personal loan to its clients since December 1, it added.
Loan recipients can pay off the whole loan or part of it at any time before maturity without any penalty, it said.
